title: CHOG//BREAK: Mutant Arena
description:
The Chog NFTs are not skins. They are genetic material.

CHOG//BREAK turns all 1,969 Chog Genesis NFTs into ingredients for a fighting game.

Pick any two real Chogs in the Lab and press SPLICE. Their actual artwork and metadata are combined into a deterministic mutant with its own appearance, moves, physics and hidden recipe possibilities. Then take that mutant into a fast side-view arena and fight.

The core loop is:

SPLICE ? REVEAL ? FIGHT ? DISCOVER ? SPLICE AGAIN

SPLICE

Seven real trait slots become genetics: Eyes, Head, Mouth, Body, Base, Accessory and Aura.

Every real trait value in the collection maps into the game.

Examples:

- Laser Eyes ? charged BEAM special
- Crown ? reduced knockback
- Skull Base ? one undead revival
- Knife ? stronger punches
- Wind Aura ? dash gust
- Bubblegum ? temporary bubble shield
- Astro Suit ? floatier physics

Rarity never directly increases strength. A Common Chog can beat a Legendary Chog.

The same two Chogs always produce the same mutant, and A × B is identical to B × A. With 1,969 Chogs, there are 1,937,496 possible pairs.

The mutant artwork is also created from the two parents' real Chog images rather than using a generic character skin.

REVEAL

The splice machine malfunctions: glass chambers, lightning, alarms and a flash.

Then the mutant appears beside its parents.

Every inherited trait is labelled with which parent it came from and what gameplay gene it created, so players can immediately understand why their experiment fights the way it does.

FIGHT

Take the mutant into a Smash-style arena against a bot on Easy, Normal or Hard, or play local 2-player.

Damage percentage rises as you are hit. Higher damage means stronger knockback. Knock your opponent outside the stage twice to win.

The arena uses Phaser for gameplay with a three.js 2.5D laboratory underneath: 3D platforms, specimen tanks, lighting, fighter shadows and animated 3D bodies carrying the mutant's real portrait.

The NFTs also mutate the arena itself.

The Background traits of the four parent Chogs involved in the fight can introduce rules such as:

- toxic floor
- low gravity
- slippery floor
- bouncy floor
- meteor showers
- coin rain
- shrinking stage
- unstable knockback

These rules affect both fighters. Bringing an NFT changes the shared rules instead of simply buying stronger stats.

DISCOVER

Sixteen hidden cross-parent recipes create named secret mutants.

Examples:

Laser Eyes + Crown ? KING BEAM

Skull + Radioactive ? NUCLEAR UNDEAD

Fwog + Frog Eyes ? FWOG LORD

Recipes change the mutant's name, appearance and add a special perk.

The Lab Notebook remembers mutants you have discovered, their fight record and secret recipes found as:

N / ???

After a fight, changing only one parent creates a different mutant, moveset and arena combination.

That makes the retention question simple:

“What happens if I splice that Chog instead?”

PROGRESSION

Bot fights earn cosmetic XP.

A mutant gains XP, but its two parent Chogs also build careers across every mutant they help create. Their wins, fights, XP and levels appear throughout the Lab, Notebook, results and MY CHOGS.

XP never increases combat stats. It records history and progression without creating pay-to-win advantages.

RECORDED SPLICE — $CHOG ON MONAD

Free experiments remain the default and require no wallet.

Players who want to permanently record an experiment can use Recorded Splice on Monad.

Registry:

"0x0EBe620530E604E6D05E0ffE7589c807E9e91527"

A normal Recorded Splice costs 10 $CHOG.

The first person to record a pair receives permanent first-discoverer credit.

Each recording distributes the fee:

- 35% to the current owner of Parent A
- 35% to the current owner of Parent B
- 20% to the prize-pool address
- 10% to the dead address

This gives individual Chogs a new kind of utility: a Chog whose genetics become popular can generate $CHOG for its current holder.

New players can also receive one sponsored first recording: they sign a message and the CHOG//BREAK sponsor pays the transaction fee and gas while the player still receives discoverer credit.

HOLDERS

Wallet connection is optional.

MY CHOGS reads the Chog Genesis contract on Monad and shows the Chogs actually held by the connected address, their genes, experiments and a SPLICE WITH… shortcut.

Simply browsing holder data is read-only.

WHY THE NFT IS ESSENTIAL

Remove Chog Genesis and CHOG//BREAK stops existing.

The real NFTs supply:

- the parent identities
- the artwork
- the genetics
- the mutant's abilities
- the visual composition
- the secret recipes
- the arena rules
- holder attribution
- optional holder payouts

Two existing NFTs become genetic inputs for a playable third entity, while those same genetics rewrite the rules of the arena.

The NFTs aren't attached to the game. They generate the game.

BUILT FOR ANYONE TO TRY

No wallet is required to play the full game.

The collection metadata and artwork were fetched from Monad/IPFS and packaged with the app, so the guest game does not depend on an RPC or IPFS gateway during play.

The first fight includes an interactive controls coach.

Desktop keyboard and mobile touch controls are supported.

1,969 Chogs. 1,937,496 experiments.

SPLICE. BREAK. REPEAT.

title: Game of Chogs
description:
Game of Chogs is a Game of Thrones parody where every one of the 1,969 Chog Genesis NFTs is a scheming noble in one shared realm on Monad. You get 3 gas a day to stab, duel, propose, feast, bend the knee or beget heirs. Every move resolves on the spot with a comic explosion. Win and a title like Kingslayer is stamped on your Chog. Fail and you do the walk of shame while the whole realm hears the bell.

Every midnight UTC the richest Chog is crowned on the Iron Toilet. The Raven, a gossip paper, prints the day's stabbings, weddings and betrayals, and the state of the realm is sealed on-chain.

What's new: the NFT isn't a profile picture you show off. It's a living character with a political career. Its record (titles, scars, spouse, liege, heirs, grudges) belongs to the token, so a Chog's history follows it across sales. Unclaimed Chogs are played by simple rule-based bots, so the realm is busy from day one, and you come back to "you were stabbed 4 times while you slept". There are no LLMs: the Raven is stitched from over 400 hand-written comedy lines.

Remove the Chog NFT and there is no game: no noble, no stats, no House, no save file and no portrait.

- Key: only the wallet that ownerOf(tokenId) returns right now can play that noble. Ownership is checked live on every move, so a sold Chog stops obeying its old lord at once.
- Stats from traits: Cunning comes from Eyes and Accessory, Might from Body and Base, Charm from Head and Mouth, plus a Tier bonus. The Background trait picks the House.
- State container: clout, titles, scars, spouse, liege and heirs are keyed by the token, not the wallet, and sealed every day to the ChogLedger contract on Monad.
- Transferable identity: sell your Chog and the buyer inherits its enemies, spouse, heirs, titles and throne claim.
- NFTs make NFTs: married Chogs can beget a Chogling, a real ERC-721 heir that records both parents on-chain. Players without a Chog can claim a free bastard NFT, minted gaslessly.
